intro:
Can you keep cool
with a demanding boss?
description:
Enjoy a light, heart-pounding office life with a boss who always seems to set the pace, all through an easygoing puzzle game!

Whether you are in work mode or taking a quick break, somehow you are never quite in control. Take on a variety of office-themed situations and enjoy the little thrills that unfold as you play.

The rules are simple!
・Look carefully at the picture
・Rotate the divided pieces as you think it through
・Restore the scene and move on to the next situation!

No complicated play is needed, so it is ideal if you fancy a casual puzzle you can dip into without fuss. Take your time on your own, or enjoy asking friends and family, “Which way should this go?”

Recommended for players who like:
・Casual puzzles that are easy to start
・Romantic or office-themed situations
・Quick play sessions in spare moments
・Observation and flashes of inspiration

Step into an office with just a hint of tension, and see if you can complete each situation waiting ahead!
